title: Lateral-to-vertical load ratio for positive projecting conduits

symbols.definition: Rankine’s ratio which may be taken as 0.33.
Fraction of conduit on which lateral pressure act (Table 3.26)

applicability: Positive projecting conduits. Values of N are given in Table 3.25 and values of Z in Table 3.26. Negative projecting conduits may use Equations 3.41 and 3.42 with k = 0.15 provided side fills are well compacted. The equations for positive projecting conditions also hold for imperfect trench conditions.
